			<strong>Open:</strong> 18:00 - 22:00 hrs<br/><strong>Tickets:</strong> € 10 		</div>
		<div class="text">
			<p>Dinner! Dindins! One of Caf&eacute; Gilde&#39;s cooks will be at the helm to bring something affordable, accessible, delectable, and sometimes, just a bit batty.</p>

<p>The deal is &euro;10 for a main and a drink, with desserts available. Easy peasy.</p>

<p>No obstacle is too high for us, so if you plan to come and have any dietary needs, let us know in advance and you&#39;ll see what a cook who actually cares about their craft does. We relish the challenge, if you want to call it as much. Just as long as it&#39;s vegan.</p>
